decision: This earlier MATIC video shows an apparent current daily descending-line break and a possible short-term chase, not an observed completed break followed by an actual retest and new order. The previously drawn line lacks a unique anchor algorithm. S12 cannot validate H06a; retain its source gate and seek a different independent completed retest.
